kaggle.gpu: T4 x2 (16 GB each) per session
kaggle.quota: about 30 GPU-h/week, 12 h/session, 2 GPU sessions (queued count)
kaggle.age: under legal contracting age -> parental-consent process (Terms)
kaggle.commercial: Terms: 'only use the Services for your own internal, personal, non-commercial use, and not on behalf of or for the benefit of any third party'
kaggle.multi_account: Terms: 'may not have, control, or operate under more than one active Kaggle account' -> second account for the same person = ban risk

kaggle_tpu.gpu: machine_shape TpuV5E8 / TpuV6E8 accepted by CLI 2.2.5
kaggle_tpu.measured: both API-pushed runs landed on a 4-vCPU / 31 GB CPU VM with jax.devices()==[CpuDevice]; no TPU attached
kaggle_tpu.verdict: not usable by automation as tested

hf_zerogpu.quota: anonymous 2 min/day, free account 5 min/day, quota belongs to the CALLER not the Space owner
hf_zerogpu.hosting: free account in good standing (verified email, >30 days old) may host 2 ZeroGPU Spaces; hosting adds no quota
hf_zerogpu.commercial: HF ToS has no non-commercial clause; model licence governs (Apache-2.0)

colab_free.gpu: T4 when available, unpublished dynamic limits, <=12 h
colab_free.restrictions: free tier disallows remote control/SSH, bypassing the notebook UI for a web UI, distributed workers; all tiers ban multiple accounts to get around limits
colab_free.automation: headless/scripted use outside the notebook UI is risky

lightning_ai.verdict: small one-time bonus at best; not a weekly source

sagemaker_studio_lab.status: AWS: no longer open to new customers (per gpuperhour, Sep 2026)

paperspace_gradient_free.verdict: cannot hold even one A14B expert; useless for this model
